landing.heroTexto: Yalope connects actors, actresses and project creators. Swipe through profiles and projects, and when the interest is mutual it's a match: you get invited and the project chat opens. Plus, your profile can be shared as a booking page.
landing.heroTextoExpansion: Yalope started to connect talent from the acting world, and is expanding to the whole artistic community: musicians, dancers, photographers, directors, producers, and more.
landing.paraArtistasTitulo: If you act, direct, or have a talent to share
landing.paraArtistasTexto: Create your profile with photos, a reel and your experience. Discover projects and teams near you, tap “I'm interested” and, if it's a match, you get invited into the project chat. You can also share your profile as a booking page with a link.
landing.paraCreadoresTitulo: If you're building a project or want to form a team
landing.paraCreadoresTexto: Got a project and missing people? Publish it with the roles you need or build a team, search profiles by area, age and skills, and invite whoever you like. Once they accept, the chat opens so you can start creating together.
landing.paso1Texto: Create your Talent profile with photos, experience, skills, and links. From there, discover and join projects and teams, or create your own to invite other talent.
landing.paso2Texto: Talent swipes projects and teams; creators swipe talent profiles. Cross to pass, heart to connect.
landing.paso3Texto: When the interest goes both ways, it's a match. The creator invites, the person accepts, and then a room opens to talk. We'll notify you even with the app closed.
landing.cierreTitulo: Your next cast, or your next role, is one match away.

aceptarNormas.texto: Before continuing, accept Yalope's Community Guidelines.
aceptarNormas.checkbox: I've read and accept Yalope's Community Guidelines.
aceptarNormas.error: You need to accept the Community Guidelines to continue.

normas.intro:
Yalope is a community built to connect artists, creators and professionals to develop artistic projects in a collaborative, respectful and professional way.

Our goal is to offer a space where ideas can become plays, shows, audiovisual productions and all kinds of creative initiatives.
normas.aceptacion: By using Yalope you agree to follow these guidelines.
normas.norma1Texto:
All community members must treat each other with respect.

Not allowed:
– Harassment or intimidation.
– Discrimination based on gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality, religion, disability or any other condition.
– Insults, threats or violent language.
– Behavior that creates a hostile environment.
normas.norma2Texto:
All published calls must contain truthful information.

We recommend stating:
– Type of project.
– Roles sought.
– Location.
– Approximate dates.
– Format: in-person, remote or hybrid.
– Whether the project is paid or not.

Publishing false or misleading calls is not allowed.
normas.norma3Texto:
Whoever creates a Project or Team is responsible for the information published and for how it develops.

Yalope facilitates contact between people, but does not take part in organizing, hiring for, or running the projects.
normas.norma4Texto:
Each user keeps the rights to their works, scripts, texts, photographs, designs, music, productions and any original content they publish.

Appropriating another user's work or using material without authorization is not allowed.
normas.norma5Texto:
Profiles must represent real people.

Not allowed:
– Creating fake profiles.
– Impersonating another person.
– Using photographs without authorization.
normas.norma6Texto:
Yalope aims to foster professional relationships.

Not allowed:
– Running scams.
– Requesting misleading payments.
– Using the platform for illegal activities.
– Publishing offensive or inappropriate content.
normas.norma7Texto:
Never share sensitive personal information with people you've just met.

In-person meetings are the responsibility of the people involved.
normas.norma8Texto:
Users can report profiles, projects or messages that break these guidelines.

Yalope will review each case and may request more information before deciding.
normas.norma9Texto:
Breaking these guidelines can lead to:
– Warnings.
– Content removal.
– Temporary account suspension.
– Permanent suspension.
normas.norma10Texto:
Yalope exists to drive artistic collaboration.

We want every project to be a chance to create, learn and connect with new people, in an environment built on trust, respect and creativity.

apoyar.intro: Yalope is a small, self-funded project. Your contribution — a donation or a sponsor spot — helps keep it running and growing.
apoyar.destino1: Build the app and add new features.
apoyar.destino2: Pay for servers and photo/video storage.
apoyar.destino3: Reach more artists and creators, in more cities.
apoyar.donarTexto: A one-off or monthly contribution, any amount. It's handled on an external payment platform.
apoyar.sponsorsTexto: A monthly contribution with your logo visible on Yalope. Three tiers, with more visibility the higher you go.
apoyar.nivel_reparto_beneficio: Your logo in the “thanks to” on this page and the homepage footer.
apoyar.nivel_coproduccion_beneficio: A larger logo in the “thanks to”, linked to your site.
apoyar.nivel_produccion_beneficio: A featured logo in the homepage banner, plus the “thanks to”.
apoyar.sponsorsComo: To become a sponsor, write to us with the form below (type “Sponsor”) and we'll sort out payment and the logo.
apoyar.contactoTexto: Tell us what you'd improve, what's missing, or why you'd like to reach out.
apoyar.enviadoOk: Thanks! We got your message and we'll get back to you.
apoyar.enviadoError: We couldn't send the message. Try again.
apoyar.enviadoLimite: We already got several messages from you in the last hour. Wait a while and write again.

privacidad.descripcion: What data Yalope keeps, what it uses it for, who sees it and how to exercise your rights.
privacidad.intro: Yalope (“Yalope”, “we”) is a platform that connects actors and creators of artistic projects. This policy explains what personal data we process when you use yalope.com and the app, why, who we share it with and how you can exercise your rights, under Argentina's Personal Data Protection Law No. 25,326. Data controller: Yalope — info@yalope.com.

parrafos: Account: your email and your password (stored encrypted by our provider; nobody at Yalope can see it). If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, your email and, only if you choose to use it, your Google photo.
Profile: name, date of birth, location, gender (and its description if you choose “Other”), photos, video reel, experience, skills, social links and your visibility preferences.
Projects and teams you create: titles, descriptions, roles, photos and rehearsal location.
Activity in the app: the “I'm interested” marks you make, your matches and casting calls, chat messages, notifications, reports and blocks.

Technical data: if you turn on notifications, your browser's subscription; if you link Discord, your Discord ID and username; your theme and language preferences; how many times you use the AI features (we don't store the texts you send); and error logs with technical data (browser, operating system and the screen where the error happened).
If you write to us through the “Support” form: your name, your email and your message.
To make the app work: showing your profile to people looking for talent, showing you projects and teams near you, setting up matches and casting calls, and opening each project's chats.
To let you know what's happening: emails (for example, when your access is approved) and phone notifications if you turn them on.
To look after the community: approving new accounts, handling reports and reviewing published content (with AI assistance, always reviewed by a person before any action is taken).
To fix errors and improve the app.
We don't sell your data or use it for advertising.

Your profile is visible to people with an approved Yalope account. Your location is shown only as a neighborhood or city: the exact address is never published. You can hide your age, and you can hide your profile from new people.
If you turn on your profile's public link, anyone with that link sees your profile without your social links.
Chat messages are visible only to the members of that chat.
Yalope's admin team can access information when needed to approve accounts, handle reports or solve technical problems.

To run, Yalope uses providers that process data on our behalf: Supabase (database, files and accounts), Vercel (app hosting), Resend (email delivery), Sentry (error logging), Google (Google sign-in and place search), OpenAI through Vercel (only when you use an AI button; the text from that moment is sent) and Discord (only if you link your account).
Some of these providers process data outside Argentina, mainly in the United States. By using Yalope you accept that international transfer, which is made with providers that apply security measures.

For as long as you have your account. From Settings → “Delete my account” your account and all your content (profile, photos, projects, teams, chats and messages) are deleted. Our providers' technical logs are deleted according to their own retention periods.

You can access, rectify, update and request deletion of your data. You can do almost everything from the app (editing your profile or deleting your account); for anything else, write to info@yalope.com.

The data subject has the right to access their personal data free of charge at intervals of no less than six months, unless a legitimate interest is shown, as established in article 14, paragraph 3 of Law No. 25,326.

The Agency for Access to Public Information, as the Control Body of Law No. 25,326, is empowered to handle complaints and claims filed by those whose rights are affected by non-compliance with the rules on personal data protection.
Yalope is for people aged 16 and over: the profile doesn't accept a date of birth indicating a younger age.

We use cookies to keep you signed in and to remember your preferences (theme, language), and while you complete your profile we keep a draft in your browser so you don't lose what you entered. We don't use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

Information travels encrypted and access to data is restricted by permissions: each person sees what concerns them. No system is infallible; if we detect a problem affecting your data, we will let you know.
If we change this policy, we will update the date above and, if the change is significant, we will let you know in the app.

terminos.intro: These terms govern the use of yalope.com and the Yalope app. By creating an account or using the service, you accept them. If you don't agree, don't use Yalope.

parrafos: Yalope is a platform that connects actors and creators of artistic projects: it lets you create a profile, publish projects and teams, mark interest, send casting calls and talk in chats.

Yalope makes contact between people easier, but it doesn't take part in organizing, hiring, paying for or carrying out the projects, and it isn't a party to the agreements people make with each other.
You must be at least 16 years old and provide true information. Each account is personal.
While the community grows, new accounts go through an approval before they can use the app.
You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for what is done from your account.

By using Yalope you accept the Community Guidelines, which are part of these terms. Among other things, harassment, discrimination, false or misleading casting calls, fake profiles, scams and deceptive payment requests are not allowed.

What you upload (photos, texts, projects, messages) remains yours. You give us permission to store it and show it within Yalope to the appropriate people, only so that the service works. That permission ends when you delete it or delete your account.
You must have the right to publish what you upload: for example, don't upload photos of other people without their permission or protected third-party content.
Whoever creates a project or team is responsible for the information they publish and for how it is carried out.
Some features use artificial intelligence to suggest texts or filters. Suggestions may contain errors: review them before using them. There is a daily usage limit.
We may review reported or published content and, if it breaches these terms or the Guidelines, warn, remove content, or suspend or delete accounts.
Yalope is free. Donations and sponsor contributions are voluntary and give no benefits within the app beyond what is described in “Support”.

We do our best to keep Yalope working well, but the service is provided as is, may have interruptions or errors, and may change. We are not responsible for agreements between users or for what happens outside the platform, including in-person meetings.
How we handle your data is explained in the Privacy Policy.
We may update these terms; if the change is significant, we will let you know in the app. They are governed by the laws of the Argentine Republic.
